id: title:haacked:fork flag calls up to 91 days old into flag evaluations

review.posthog_relevance: Changes retention window for fork-flag evaluation data, potentially retaining older event data longer.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H2 explicitly changes a retention period from 90 to 93 days for fork-flag evaluations. This is a localized maintenance change affecting data retention duration. No broader systemic capability or critical path improvement is demonstrated. The score is assigned based on the observed code change, not unverified benefits.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of retaining an additional day of data is not demonstrated; this could be a minor cleanup or a potential increase in storage costs without clear benefit. No tests or checks are shown to support the change's correctness or necessity.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains only test and implementation changes. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Retained the retention period for fork-flag evaluations from 90 to 92 days.
observations.code_quote: flagCalledOverrides: { timestamp: DateTime.utc().minus({ days: 93 }).toISO() as ISOTimestamp },
